description: Elastic backend: drop the three verified high-volume Codex CLI streaming-delta event docs (service.name=codex_cli_rs only) — response.output_text.delta, response.function_call_arguments.delta, response.custom_tool_call_input.delta. These are content-free incremental fragments (the complete value lands on the terminal .done event; Codex's export strips conversation content from them entirely), together ~91% of the event/log_only stream. `?.` is required: event_kind is absent on the valuable events (codex.user_prompt, codex.tool_result, response.completed, …) and null == '…' is safely false, so they are kept. Explicit allowlist, not endsWith('.delta'): a wildcard would blindly drop unverified/future .delta kinds (refusal, reasoning-summary, …) — a new kind joins only after its reconstructability is verified. Also redacts the raw tool I/O (labels.arguments / labels.output) on codex_cli_rs's codex.tool_result log_only twin to [REDACTED] — the sensitive command line and stdout are replaced at ingest so they never persist in ES; the trace_safe metadata twin (sizes, success) is untouched.
